rationale: All four configurations achieved aggregate precision@1 = 0 and recall@1 = 0 on the two evaluation cases. It is selected as a provisional baseline rather than a production-ready solution because neither evaluation case returned the expected relevant fragment. Further retrieval improvements and evaluation are required.
